brief:
Settlers have besieged Palestinian homes in Qusra, in the West Bank, according to Middle East Eye, with Israeli authorities restricting food supplies to the area. Around 15 people, including children, remain trapped in the community as the siege continues.

The blockade has left residents without adequate provisions. Those affected describe severe food scarcity, with supplies unable to reach the trapped households. The restrictions combine direct settler actions with Israeli limitations on movement and delivery of goods into the besieged area.

title: Settlers besiege Palestinian homes in West Bank, restrict food supply
